newsitem.title: USA: Claridge Hotel says Hilton talks terminated.
newsitem.headline: Claridge Hotel says Hilton talks terminated.

text.p: Claridge Hotel and Casino Corp, owner of Claridge Casino Hotel here, Thursday said discussions with Hilton Hotels Corp about the possible acquisition of Claridge by Hilton have been terminated.
In a statement, Claridge did not disclose the reason for the talks ending. A Hilton spokeswoman declined to comment.

Claridge Hotel and Casino Corporation is a closely-held company with bonds traded on the New York Stock Exchange. The Claridge Casino Hotel was opened in July 1981 and has 59,000 square feet of casino gaming space. It is adjacent to Bally's Park Place hotel, which is owned by Hilton.
